mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the average forward return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.7 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which leads the Fed to delay rate cuts and suppresses equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1700.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real economic output, which triggers a market reassessment of corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment where the Fed maintains restrictive policy, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 290.0 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.75%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 670 billion dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong aggregate demand and potential overheating, prompting the Fed to delay easing and suppressing equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 670000.0 and INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation expectations, leading to a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 19700 billion dollars, combined with rising residential construction, signals strong economic momentum that increases inflation risks and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 exceeds 19700 and HOUST exceeds 1700, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
